title: Compass configuration
description: Schema for compass.yaml at the root of a host project. Loaded by Sidetours\Compass\Engine\Configuration::load() at the start of every `compass check`, `compass baseline`, and `compass prompts` invocation.

paths.title: Scan paths
paths.description: Directories or files Compass walks for *.php sources. Entries are resolved relative to the project root (the directory the CLI was launched from); absolute paths are accepted as-is.

exclude.title: Exclude globs
exclude.description: Path globs to skip during the file walk. Supports '*' (single segment), '**' (recursive), and '?' (single char). Plain strings without glob characters are matched as directory prefixes.

phpVersion.title: PHP version target
phpVersion.description: PHP version your project targets (dotted form, e.g. "8.1" or "8.1.2"). When set, every built-in rule whose feature is available at or before this version is auto-included via Sidetours\Compass\Rules\BuiltInRules::applicableTo(). Composes with the explicit `rules` list (deduplicated). Version-agnostic rules (final-classes, no-else-after-return, no-service-location) are NEVER auto-included by phpVersion — list them under `rules` if you want them. At least one of `rules` or `phpVersion` must be present.

rules.title: Activated rules
rules.description: List of rule identifiers Compass should run. Each entry is either a built-in short name (matches Rule::name() of a class shipped with the package) or a fully-qualified PHP class name of a custom rule that implements Sidetours\Compass\Rules\Rule. Custom-rule entries MUST contain a backslash so the loader can disambiguate them from built-in names. Built-in rules are presented under two orthogonal groupings: by intent (Type Safety, Modern PHP, Code Hygiene, Architecture) and by the PHP version that introduced the language feature each rule enforces (PHP 7.0 through PHP 8.3). A rule typically appears in one branch from each grouping. Optional when `phpVersion` is set; the two settings compose.

anyOf.title: Type Safety
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that enforce explicit native PHP types end-to-end.

anyOf.title: Modern PHP
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that push call and declaration sites to use PHP 8+ syntax (named arguments, constructor property promotion, str_contains, match, first-class callable syntax, array spread operator, readonly classes).

anyOf.title: Code Hygiene
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that improve readability and simplicity (early returns, final classes, numeric literal separators).

anyOf.title: Architecture
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that enforce design boundaries between layers (e.g. no service-location in Domain/Application).

anyOf.title: PHP 7.0
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that enforce features introduced in PHP 7.0.

anyOf.title: PHP 7.4
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that enforce features introduced in PHP 7.4 (typed properties, array spread operator, numeric literal separator).

anyOf.title: PHP 8.0
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that enforce features introduced in PHP 8.0 (named arguments, constructor property promotion, str_contains, match).

anyOf.title: PHP 8.1
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that enforce features introduced in PHP 8.1 (first-class callable syntax, never return type).

anyOf.title: PHP 8.2
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that enforce features introduced in PHP 8.2 (readonly classes).

anyOf.title: PHP 8.3
anyOf.description: Built-in rules that enforce features introduced in PHP 8.3 (typed class constants).

anyOf.title: Custom rule (PHP FQCN)
anyOf.description: Fully-qualified class name of a class implementing Sidetours\Compass\Rules\Rule. Must contain a backslash.

ignore.title: Glob-based suppressions
ignore.description: Map of file glob => list of rule short names to suppress for matching files. Use ['*'] to silence every Compass rule for that glob. Glob syntax is the same as 'exclude'. Suppressions complement, but are independent of, the baseline file.

baseline.title: Baseline file path
baseline.description: Path (relative to project root, or absolute) of an auto-generated PHP file holding violation fingerprints to suppress. Pre-existing violations recorded there stay quietly tracked; new ones still fail CI. Generated by `compass baseline`. Omit to disable baselining.
